name: Hard Rain, Cold Light
promptTemplate: A stark downpour illuminated by a {{spot_style}} spotlight in {{palette}}, rain parting into dry sanctuaries of {{pocket_scale}} scale with {{mist_density}} ground haze and {{weather_fury}} intensity.

palette.hint: Switch the beam and reflection colours

pocket_scale.hint: Expand the dry aura around each person

weather_fury.hint: Speed and intensity of falling droplets

mist_density.hint: Toggle floor splash vapor and haze

listing.blurb: A hard searchlight cuts through an intense downpour over reflective pavement, while dry sanctuary domes deflect the falling rain around people in the room.
listing.prompt: A room of falling rain lit by a single hard spotlight from the side, every streak glinting, with dry pockets that open around the people standing in it -- one pocket per person in the room, drifting slowly -- splashes and mist where the rain meets the floor. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
